subject: Client X year-end: benefits in kind on the annual statement
body:
Hi Jan,

I'm preparing the year-end run for Scheldemond Logistics and I see several employees with a company car and a phone subscription. Do these benefits in kind go on the annual tax form as a separate line, or are they already included in the taxable gross? The checklist I have is from two years ago.

Thanks a lot,
Anna

filler.signature: Anna Claes · Junior payroll consultant · Pay team · +32 2 000 00 04
filler.disclaimer: This message is confidential and intended only for the addressee. If you received it in error, please notify the sender and delete it.

subject: Re: Client X year-end: benefits in kind on the annual statement
body:
Hi Anna,

They go on a separate line (code 250 on the annual form), but they are also part of the taxable gross, so don't add them twice. For Scheldemond there is one extra point: the phone subscription is a flat-rate benefit agreed with the client, not the actual cost. It's all in the current Client X year-end note, linked below. Throw away the old checklist, it predates the flat-rate agreement.

Shout if anything is unclear before the run on Thursday.

Jan

Lucas

subject: Re: Ardenne: absence codes for seasonal workers

Use the reduced list for short contracts (it's in the absence code guide, table 4). Seasonal workers at Ardenne don't get the small-leave codes, and sickness in the first month goes through the standard code but Pay handles the guaranteed salary differently. Loop in the Pay team if they ask about the salary side, that's not ours.
